label: Mobile app development
summary: Explore the work behind researching, designing, building and supporting a mobile app.
notes: A selected native Android route, with Google Play as one distribution and support example. Research, design and testing recur; this is not a prescribed sequence or the only mobile technology stack.

label: Mobile app
summary: An installable mobile application, represented here by an Android app.

label: Research and planning
summary: Understand users and organize research around important questions.

label: Interaction design
summary: Explore interface ideas through prototypes and feedback.

label: Development
summary: Write and build the app’s code and interface.

label: Testing
summary: Check whether the app behaves as intended.

label: Distribution
summary: Prepare a release and make it available to users.

label: Support
summary: Respond to users’ feedback and reported problems.

label: User researcher
summary: Investigates users’ tasks, experiences and needs.

label: Interaction designer
summary: Explores and tests how people will interact with a service.

label: Mobile app developer
summary: Writes and changes code that implements an app.

label: Software tester
summary: Checks app behavior across scenarios, devices and configurations.

label: App publisher
summary: Prepares release materials and makes an app available to users.

label: App support specialist
summary: Reviews feedback and helps users with reported app problems.

label: User research
summary: Interview and observe people to understand their goals and difficulties.

label: Interface prototyping
summary: Make and test rough versions of an interface to explore ideas.

label: Android app development
summary: Use Kotlin and Jetpack Compose to build an Android interface.

label: App testing
summary: Choose and run checks of an app’s behavior and usability.

label: User needs
summary: What people need from a service to achieve their intended outcome.

label: Programming functions
summary: Units of code that perform a task when called.

label: Functional testing
summary: Checking whether an app does what it is intended to do.

label: Android Studio
summary: A development workspace for editing, building and previewing Android apps.

label: Android test device
summary: A physical or emulated Android device used to run app checks.

label: Play Console
summary: A developer dashboard for examining app feedback and replying to users.

label: Your first Kotlin program
summary: Write, run and change a small program in a browser.
notes: Requires an internet-connected computer and browser. This introduces programming, not a complete Android app. Page text is CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted; code examples use Apache 2.0.

label: Create your first Android app
summary: Build and customize a simple Android greeting app using Android Studio. Basic Kotlin knowledge required.
notes: Basic Kotlin and Android Studio required. Text uses CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted; code samples use Apache 2.0.
